_about: V68: lock-on camera pose multipliers on the V3 closed form (CameraRig.cs). heightMul < 1 lowers the camera = lower pitch (V3 pose ~22 deg down at 4 m gap), so the horizon, eclipse and ruins rise in the frame. backMul pulls back, lookYAdd raises the look-at, shoulder = sideways offset in m. 1,1,0,1 = the old pose.
